items.quote: Currently at? Two cycles Is it two? Two and a half. It generally goes up to the outer limit of 90 days because that's industry now. 90 days? Yeah.

items.quote: So you will not have a problem operating cash flows because as you know the margins are very large compared to the receivables. So the operating cash flows are very positive.

items.statement: Reduced controlling interest in NCCCL from 69% to 54% to repay loan; no immediate plan to further divest stake
items.quote: We don't. No, we don't. So this was a pre-emptive idea at. The point of purchase itself. We had agreed that both with the. Lenders as well as with the as well as with the management that. We will be holding majority stake of 54%.

items.statement: No immediate fundraising planned; new products like tokenization and SM REIT will raise own capital when launched
items.quote: Like considering we discussed about tokenization, we discussed about smd, discussed about other products within the pipeline. So all of these obviously when they Get launched will obviously raise their own capital.

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative in FY25 but turned positive in H1 FY26; management expects it to stay positive going forward.
items.quote: Sir, so if you can see the FY '25 and the first h alf of FY '26, FY '25, the operating cash flow were negative and H1 '26 was on a positive side. So we are trying our level best to keep on the same track only. So going forward also, we are expecting the cash flow from operations to be on a positive side only
